summary: IDS feed c057_span is severely degraded: SPAN destination is oversubscribed (2.13 Gbps mirrored into 1 Gbps port) causing 53.03% packet loss before traffic reaches the IDS.

findings.root_cause: SPAN oversubscription at DIST-SW-02: Gi1/0/1 mirrors 22,810,680 packets (2.13 Gbps) into Gi1/0/48 SPAN destination which is only 1 Gbps. Destination sent only 10,714,260 packets and discarded 12,096,420 on output (100% load, bursts higher) = 53.03% loss. SPAN cannot buffer bursts and drops excess.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS (needs both directions and full payload, 1 Gbps port) receives only ~47% of traffic. Majority of flows incomplete, signatures and anomaly detection blind to >50% of attacks, high false-negative risk and broken flow reassembly.

params.broker_handling: feed TAP to packet broker then filter/load-balance to fit 1 Gbps IDS or upgrade IDS/broker port to 10 Gbps to handle 2.13 Gbps

recommended_fix.why: Passive TAP eliminates SPAN copy loss and burst drops. Broker can then aggregate, filter irrelevant traffic, or load-balance across multiple 1 Gbps IDS ports, or justify upgrading IDS ingest to 10 Gbps so 2.13 Gbps fits without 53% loss.
